name: Defending Champions
criteria: Automatic invitation extended to the winning team of WRTC 2026 UK.

name: Wild Card Teams
description: Teams nominated by WRTC 2030 Organizing Committee
criteria: Reserved at the discretion of the WRTC OC to recognize exceptional operators from the applicant pool who did not otherwise qualify (Autumn 2029).

name: Youth Teams
description: Under age 25 at the finish of the first qualifying event (20 Dec 2026)
criteria: Best 6 of 24 qualifying event scores worldwide among youth applicants under age 25.

name: Sponsored Teams
description: Teams selected through applications and bidding auction
criteria: Selected through formal application and sponsorship auction opening after 1 January 2029 per Selection Rules §8.D.
